intitule: Conjugating Regular Verbs in Past Simple

enonce.texte:
Write the past simple form of the following regular verbs. Add -ed or -d to the base form.

  1. walk
  2. play
  3. dance
  4. study
  5. stop
  6. arrive
  7. cook
  8. clean

questions.texte: Write the past simple form of each verb.
questions.reponse: 1. walked, 2. played, 3. danced, 4. studied, 5. stopped, 6. arrived, 7. cooked, 8. cleaned

sousQuestions.texte: Explain the spelling rule for verbs ending in 'y' (study).
sousQuestions.reponse: For verbs ending in consonant + y, change 'y' to 'i' and add '-ed' (studied).

enonce.texte:
Match the past time expressions with their meanings.

ExpressionMeaning
yesterdaya period of 7 days ago
last weekthe day before today
two years agoin the month before this one
last monthtwo years in the past

questions.texte: Match each expression with its correct meaning.
questions.reponse: yesterday - the day before today; last week - a period of 7 days ago; two years ago - two years in the past; last month - in the month before this one

sousQuestions.texte: What does 'ago' mean in past time expressions?
sousQuestions.reponse: 'Ago' means a certain amount of time before now (e.g., two years ago = two years before now).

enonce.texte:
Change the following sentences into questions in the past simple. Use Did + subject + base form of the verb.

  1. She visited her grandmother.
  2. They played football.
  3. He finished his homework.
  4. We watched a movie.
  5. You called me yesterday.

questions.texte: Transform each sentence into a question.
questions.reponse: 1. Did she visit her grandmother? 2. Did they play football? 3. Did he finish his homework? 4. Did we watch a movie? 5. Did you call me yesterday?

sousQuestions.texte: What is the rule for forming questions in the past simple?
sousQuestions.reponse: Use 'Did' + subject + base form of the verb. The main verb does not take '-ed' in questions.

enonce.texte: Write a short paragraph (5-7 sentences) about what you did yesterday. Use past time expressions (yesterday, last night, in the morning) and regular verbs in the past simple.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph describing your day yesterday.
questions.reponse: Example: 'Yesterday, I woke up at 7 AM. I cooked breakfast and ate it. Then, I walked to school. I studied English and listened to music. In the evening, I visited my friend. We played games and watched TV. I slept at 10 PM.'

enonce.texte: Interview a classmate about their activities last weekend. Write 5 questions using Did you...? and then write their answers in complete sentences.

questions.texte: Write 5 interview questions and the responses.
questions.reponse: Example: Q1: Did you go to the market? A1: Yes, I did. Q2: Did you cook a meal? A2: No, I didn't. Q3: Did you watch a movie? A3: Yes, I did. Q4: Did you visit your family? A4: Yes, I did. Q5: Did you play football? A5: No, I didn't.

enonce.texte:
Find and correct the mistakes in these past simple sentences.

  1. I visit my friend yesterday.
  2. She doesn't called me.
  3. Did he watched the news?
  4. They didn't studied hard.
  5. We walk to school last week.

questions.texte: Correct the mistakes in each sentence.
questions.reponse: 1. I visited my friend yesterday. 2. She didn't call me. 3. Did he watch the news? 4. They didn't study hard. 5. We walked to school last week.

sousQuestions.texte: Why is 'didn't' followed by the base form of the verb?
sousQuestions.reponse: In negative sentences, 'didn't' is already in the past tense, so the main verb stays in the base form.

enonce.texte: Write a short story (8-10 sentences) about a memorable event from your childhood. Use regular and some common irregular verbs (e.g., go, have, see) in the past simple.

questions.texte: Write a story about a childhood memory.
questions.reponse: Example: 'When I was a child, I lived in a small village. I went to school every day. I played with my friends in the afternoon. One day, we visited my grandmother. She cooked a delicious meal. We walked to the river and swam. I had a happy childhood. I remember those days with joy.'

enonce.texte:
Rewrite the sentences in the negative form.

  1. I walked to school.
  2. She played the piano.
  3. They visited the museum.
  4. We studied English.
  5. He cooked dinner.

questions.texte: Rewrite each sentence as a negative sentence.
questions.reponse: 1. I didn't walk to school. 2. She didn't play the piano. 3. They didn't visit the museum. 4. We didn't study English. 5. He didn't cook dinner.

sousQuestions.texte: What is the structure of a negative past simple sentence?
sousQuestions.reponse: Subject + didn't + base form of the verb + object/complement.

enonce.texte: Describe your daily routine from last year. Compare it with your current routine. Use past simple and time expressions.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph comparing your past and present routines.
questions.reponse: Example: 'Last year, I woke up at 6 AM. I walked to school. I studied French and math. Now, I wake up at 7 AM. I take the bus to school. I study English and science. Last year, I didn't have a smartphone. Now, I use my phone to study.'

enonce.texte:
Complete the dialogue with the past simple form of the verbs in brackets.

Anna: What _______ you _______ (do) yesterday?

Ben: I _______ (go) to the park and _______ (play) with my friends.

Anna: _______ you _______ (watch) a movie?

Ben: No, I _______. I _______ (study) for my English test.

questions.texte: Fill in the blanks with the correct past simple forms.
questions.reponse: did, do; went, played; Did, watch; didn't, studied
